description: list() contract for the data-files `files` SDK: KEELSON_FILES_PREFIX is stripped from each GCS object name, keys are returned in a single cross-language order (UTF-8 byte order == Python code-point order == Go byte order == Node compareUtf8), and paging is absorbed internally. Includes a BMP private-use char (U+E000) and a non-BMP char (U+10000) to lock the ordering: JS's default UTF-16 sort would place U+10000 (surrogate 0xD800) before U+E000 — wrong.
